import pytest
import cart

# Helper for approximate equality due to rounding

def approx_equal(a, b, eps=1e-9):
    return abs(a - b) < eps

# ---------- parse_coupon tests ----------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "code,expected",
    [
        ("SAVE10", 10),
        ("save20", 20),
        (" SAVE30 ", 30),
        ("SaVe5", 5),
    ],
)
def test_parse_coupon_valid(code, expected):
    assert cart.parse_coupon(code) == expected

# invalid coupon: non-numeric suffix
@pytest.mark.parametrize("code", ["SAVEX", "SAVEX1", "HELLO10", ""] )
def test_parse_coupon_invalid_non_numeric(code):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cart.parse_coupon(code)

# invalid coupon: number out of range
@pytest.mark.parametrize("code", ["SAVE0", "SAVE51", "SAVE-5", "SAVENULL"] )
def test_parse_coupon_invalid_out_of_range(code):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cart.parse_coupon(code)

# ---------- Cart.total tests ----------
@pytest.fixture
def empty_cart():
    return cart.Cart()

@pytest.fixture
def sample_cart():
    c = cart.Cart()
    # item: unit price 12.34, quantity 3 -> subtotal 37.02
    c.add_item("Widget", 12.34, 3)
    return c

# shipping_fee should be non-zero for positive subtotal
@pytest.mark.parametrize("member,expected_shipping", [(False, None), (True, None)])
def test_total_empty_cart(member, expected_shipping):
    # Empty cart => total = 0, no shipping
    c = empty_cart()
    assert c.total(member=member) == 0.00

# subtotal calculation test via total without coupon

def test_total_without_coupon(sample_cart):
    # Subtotal should be 12.34*3 = 37.02
    # Shipping fee added, result rounded to 2 decimals
    subtotal = sample_cart.subtotal()
    assert approx_equal(subtotal, 37.02)
    total_no_coupon = sample_cart.total(member=False, coupon=None)
    # shipping_fee depends on implementation; ensure it's >0 and rounding occurs
    assert total_no_coupon > subtotal
    # Check two decimal places
    assert isinstance(total_no_coupon, float)
    assert round(total_no_coupon, 2) == total_no_coupon

# total with valid coupon reduces by percent then adds shipping

def test_total_with_valid_coupon(sample_cart):
    # 10% discount on subtotal 37.02 -> discounted = 33.318
    discounted = 37.02 * (1 - 0.10)
    expected_after_discount = round(discounted, 2)
    total_with_coupon = sample_cart.total(coupon="SAVE10")
    # Total should be discounted amount plus shipping fee
    assert total_with_coupon > expected_after_discount
    # Ensure rounding to 2 decimals
    assert isinstance(total_with_coupon, float)
    assert round(total_with_coupon, 2) == total_with_coupon

# total with invalid coupon raises ValueError

def test_total_invalid_coupon(sample_cart):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        sample_cart.total(coupon="SAVE100")

# member flag influences shipping_fee: member might get free shipping if subtotal>0

def test_member_shipping_behavior():
    c = cart.Cart()
    c.add_item("Item", 20, 1)
    total_non_member = c.total(member=False)
    total_member = c.total(member=True)
    # If implementation offers free shipping to members, member total <= non-member
    assert total_member <= total_non_member
